searchText: if anyone wants to experiment with the `mev-rs` stack, i just pushed a "mock" relay approximately like the one in `mergemock` i don't think it is exactly conformant with `mergemock` but it does work w/ `mev-boost-rs` so it is at least self-consistent and you will be able to verify your signing routines are working correctly to run (assuming you have a rust toolchain w/ cargo already): ``` $ git clone https://github.com/ralexstokes/mev-rs $ cd mev-rs $ cargo run relay mock example.config.toml # to run the mock `mev-relay-rs` $ cargo run boost example.config.toml # to run `mev-boost-rs` ``` https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/15 has been merged so i'd suggest we cut a `v0.0.1` of the builder specs and then we will all have something tangible to target, e.g. for static test vectors (cc <@363800010518822915> ) guys i think i missed the bus on why register_validator is a separate api than prepare_beacon_proposer, i though the beacon proposer was to be extended There's a bunch of context in the PR: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/209 (and in #206, the previous PR extending `prepare_beacon_proposer`) thank you! 🙂 🙏 thanks for all the feedback on https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/18 i have addressed the first round of PR feedback, please take another look when you have time question RE: https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/18/files#diff-ce744e1cad583b1f3a0f41dfd5b0e5c292d9cb0bbb6201c10d7271e523f33be5R139-R144 won't the blinded block often have different transactions since presumably the builder will be doing MEV that the local node isn't? asking here vs on the PR so as not to pollute the PR if I misunderstand, but if it's worth discussing on the PR I'll add it as a comment. Mainly asking cause if it is the case that the tx list (and thus signature) will often be different then I think maybe that section should be worded more strongly. almost certainly the txs will be different and other params in the block like gas limit as well feel free to suggest a change in language, etc. i think this section should follow the tone of the consensus-specs validator guide(s) so reading e.g. this may be helpful context: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/validator.md#how-to-avoid-slashing we could even toss a link to that document in there if you want this document in the builder specs is for validator client devs who i assume have all the working context of the consensus-specs

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content:
if anyone wants to experiment with the `mev-rs` stack, i just pushed a "mock" relay approximately like the one in `mergemock`

i don't think it is exactly conformant with `mergemock` but it does work w/ `mev-boost-rs` so it is at least self-consistent and you will be able to verify your signing routines are working correctly

to run (assuming  you have a rust toolchain w/ cargo already):
```
$ git clone https://github.com/ralexstokes/mev-rs
$ cd mev-rs
$ cargo run relay mock example.config.toml # to run the mock `mev-relay-rs`
$ cargo run boost example.config.toml      # to run `mev-boost-rs`
```

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/15 has been merged so i'd suggest we cut a `v0.0.1` of the builder specs and then we will all have something tangible to target, e.g. for static test vectors (cc <@363800010518822915> )
